quote: In May 14, we were in Cassino with my mother in law so that she could to visit her brother’s grave in CWGC cemetery. He had served in 2 Beds & Herts and was killed in the Fourth Battle. Whilst in the town, we joined Frank de Planta’s battlefield tour and have no hesitation in recommending it for those looking for an in depth assessment of the conflict. Frank was a great guide, full of knowledge and enthusiasm, and although the tour timetable was disrupted by the visit of HRH Prince Harry, Frank was able to quickly rearrange the timings so that we did not miss anything. If you are going to Monte Cassino, make sure that you go on Frank de Planta’s battlefield tour: you will not be disappointed.
name: Paul Bodsworth
